note: Music bed for the Spider-Man 2 reel pack (2026-11-15): one section per reel, starting on its first beat; short crossfade so each reel opens on its own track. R01 (Kraven, the kill order) on the tension bed, R02 (the alien suit) on the main theme. Never the game's own soundtrack. Levels as the long-forms.
credits: "Last Dawn" and "Epic and Dramatic Trailer Music" by Ross Bugden
